topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic establishes the lecture's framing by connecting to histopathology practicals and detailing the learning objectives.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Cancer and Oncogene Discovery
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the history of tumor virology and explain how retroviral gene capture led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes.

topics.label: Experimental Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic focuses on the in vitro and in vivo assays used to evaluate the transforming capacity of candidate cancer genes and mutations.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Cellular Consequences of Oncogenic Mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the classification of cancer genes and examine how specific mutational mechanisms alter cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Forms and Pathways of Genetic Instability in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the cellular defects in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and mitosis that generate sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multistep Genetic Progression of Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the stepwise accumulation and temporal ordering of mutations driving the progression from normal tissue to malignancy.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations accelerate tumorigenesis and influence ongoing tumor adaptation.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-Up and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic concludes the lecture by summarizing coverage, offering reading material, and previewing upcoming topics.
